note: Primary: SEGA press release of 29 Jun 2026 (reposted in full by The Outerhaven, 'Source: Press Release'): launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on October 29, 2026; 60FPS and higher-quality visuals over the Switch version; all 54 characters; free upgrade pass for Switch owners (Character Pass not included); physical edition with the Infinity Castle Character Pass at $59.99 MSRP; cross-gen VS with Switch. No Switch 2 footage outside YouTube, so the Steam launch trailer (PC version) is used with an on-screen stand-in credit. Sound: the trailer's own music 61 to 77 s, no speech (speech ends at 56.1 s).
